description: Systems lack appropriate access control measures to ensure that only authorized personnel can access personal data. Access control includes authentication, authorization, least privilege, separation of duties, and access monitoring.
applicability: Applicable to all systems storing or processing personal data. Includes user authentication systems, database access, API endpoints, administrative interfaces, file storage, and processor access to controller data.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through access control configuration review and code analysis. Look for missing authentication, weak passwords, shared credentials, overly permissive roles, lack of MFA, no access logs, missing authorization checks, default credentials, and inadequate access provisioning/deprovisioning processes. Verify processor personnel access is documented and authorized.

sources.title: EDPB Guidelines on Security of Processing
